name: Operational Complexity & Sustainment Friction Holdout Family
description: Tests candidate autonomy predictors under elevated operational tempo, higher contact frequency, and supply transport friction not present in the Stage-3 discovery grid.

experimental_manipulation.rationale: High operating friction tests whether candidate Omega coordinates correctly weight sustainment burn versus tactical capability.

pass_fail_criteria.decision_rule: The frozen discovery predictor must achieve Spearman rho >= 0.60 and MAE <= 0.25 on long horizons (90d and 180d) without parameter recalibration.
